items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: he started his jazz sessions, his jazz party with the nucleus of some from the Odessa parties, but adding a few younger, more modern generation musicians to add a different flavor to the music, and I was asked to open that first party.

ctx.x: But we still go on, and I'll be there this May, and many other musicians he loved will be there, too. I believe that Jim Fulcher will be with us, also. It's a wierd feeling that we can't see him, but we will feel him.

Another insert on the jazz parties, was one of our fans in the Odessa parties was a gentleman called Max Christianson from Midland, Texas -- of course, that's only 30 minutes away, about 30 or 40 miles from Odessa.

So two years ago in '77, he decided that they wanted a session over there in Midland, along the same lines, but with a few different musicians to add a little flavor, around November, which would be -- our parties in Odessa were in May, and that would be mid-year, so that would be six months apart, and he started his jazz sessions, his jazz party with the nucleus of some from the Odessa parties, but adding a few younger, more modern generation musicians to add a different flavor to the music, and I was asked to…
